appearances.snippet: The project that has been presented and the scale of the area involved makes it highly destructive. There'll be 10,000 rooms and construction will last 10 to 15 years.

verification.notes: PPNEA publicly estimates about 10,000 rooms and 10 to 15 years of construction, and multiple outlets report the 10,000-room figure. Albania officials said a final proposal and environmental study were not yet complete, so these are campaigner estimates rather than settled project specifications.
